facts: Hound dogs and long-nosed dogs also have a unique name for their head-type: "Dolichocephalic."
Dogs can see in color, but not as vividly as humans.
A dog's sense of smell is so powerful that they can detect a drop of blood in a large swimming pool.
A dog's nose is the equivalent of a human's fingerprints, as no two dogs have the same nose print.
Puppies love games such as hide and seek! Hide, then call your pup's name so she can try to find you.
